entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="見てよ。1600ccの直列6気筒。これがまたいい音を奏でるの" t="Just look at 'er – 1600cc straight-six engine – an' you know how she purrs, choom? How she sounds?!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="見てよ。1600ccの直列6気筒。これがまたいい音を奏でるの" t="Uită-te la ea – motor straight-six de 1600cc – și știi cum toarce, choom? Cum sună?!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="下痢してるときみたいな音だろ？" t="Like a colossal waste of scratch?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="下痢してるときみたいな音だろ？" t="Ca o pierdere colossală de bani?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="今に見てな。そっちのちゃっちい電池式のガラクタなんか、置いてけぼりにしてやるから" t="'Ey, just wait till I wake this baby up. Your battery-powered choo-choo won't stand a chance." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="今に見てな。そっちのちゃっちい電池式のガラクタなんか、置いてけぼりにしてやるから" t="Hei, așteaptă să trezesc copila asta. Trenulețul tău pe baterii n-are nicio șansă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ふん、まずは走れるようにしてから言えよ" t="Pfft, get 'er on the road first, then we'll see." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ふん、まずは走れるようにしてから言えよ" t="Pfft, pune-o pe șosea mai întâi, apoi vedem." b="" a=""/>
